title: Book Three · Chapter 76: Just the Two of Them
story:
On Saturday, Ronan finishes Mum's delivery in the morning.

He eats lunch, then changes into a clean shirt. At the park, he reaches the tree before half past two.

There is no ball and no box of food today. He sits down, stands up, and sits again.

Anna comes along the path with her hands in her coat pockets.

“Am I late?”

“No. I was early.”

She stops beside the bench. Neither of them sits for a moment.

“A walk?” she asks.

Ronan nods. They take the wider path around the grass.

Anna talks about her morning run. Lin tried a faster last part. Anna stayed at her own speed and reached the tree a little later.

“I didn't want tired legs for the whole day,” she says.

Ronan smiles. “Good planning.”

Then they are quiet. He can hear their shoes on the path. He has thought about these words all week.

Once, he begins with her name.

Anna turns toward him.

“Yes?”

A child runs across the path with a long stick. Ronan moves his bag out of the way. Another child calls from near the bench.

He looks back at Anna. The words he practised at home have gone quiet again.

“Was it a question?” she asks.

“Yes.”

“You can ask.”

He nods and takes another few steps. Anna walks beside him at the same slow pace.

He knows how to begin a story in class. He can ask a classmate to repeat a sentence. This question has familiar words too. Still, he keeps moving his thumb along the edge of his bag.

Anna does not answer a question he has not asked. She waits while they walk toward the quieter part of the park.

Ronan looks up from the path. There is nobody between them and the far gate now.

Near the far gate, he stops.

“Anna, I like you.”

She looks at him.

“I like you too.”

“I mean...”

He looks down once, then back at her.

“Will you be my girlfriend?”

Anna's smile grows. “Yes.”

Ronan takes a breath. He nearly laughs, but the sound does not come out properly.

“Good,” he says.

Anna laughs for both of them.

“Was that the whole question?”

“The hard part.”

She takes one hand from her pocket. Ronan looks at it, then takes it gently in his own.

Her fingers are cool. They stand like that for a moment before they start to walk again.

The park looks the same. A man is brushing leaves near the bench. Two children are arguing about a stick.

Ronan can see all of it more clearly than before.

At the next turn, Anna moves her bag to her other shoulder. They let go of each other's hands. Then she takes his hand again.

“I still have my run with Lin tomorrow,” she says.

“I know.”

“And a whole page of maths.”

“I have two pages.”

“Then this walk needs to end sometime.”

“Not at this tree.”

She smiles. They go past it and take the longer part of the path.

Before they leave, they sit on the bench for a few minutes. Ronan keeps her hand in his. Neither talks very much.

At the crossing, they separate for the two roads home.

“See you on Monday,” Anna says.

Ronan nods. He walks toward West Lane with his empty hand inside his pocket.

At home, he puts his school book on the table and opens it. He reads the first question twice. This time, the question is not the difficult part of the afternoon.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

girlfriend＝女朋友；properly＝顺畅地、正常地；gently＝轻轻地；let go＝松开。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan问了什么明确的问题？Anna怎样回应？
2. 关系有进展后，两人是否取消了各自的朋友、跑步和学习安排？

## 读句子

**Then she takes his hand again.**

拆开看：Then / she takes his hand / again.

然后／她又牵住他的手／再一次。
